method.title: How we count
method.data: We only use mod players’ own shots: damage on penetration and the shell’s nominal damage. Killing shots, HE and unknown shells are excluded — their damage is capped or depends on armor.
method.theory: The theoretical curve is a normal distribution truncated at ±25% of nominal. The mean roll is how far total damage sits above or below nominal.
method.fairPlay: The mod reads nothing about enemies: only the results of your own battles.
